_comment: When Herobrine speaks. Times are in seconds of game time (20 ticks a second, so real time on a healthy server).
triggers: moments the mod reports. categories are tried in order, so rare ones go first.
chance: does he say anything at all; cooldown: before this trigger can make him speak again;
delay: [min, max] pause before the line; patience: how long it may wait for a quiet moment;
appear: chance he also shows himself nearby; in_combat: may speak mid-fight.
categories: limits on a whole category whichever trigger offers it.
On top of all this, config/herobrine.json sets the minimum gap between any two lines (voiceMinGapSeconds).
